Model inversion via multi-fidelity Bayesian optimization: a new paradigm for parameter estimation in haemodynamics, and beyond

High FEA & Surrogate Modelling openalex Transferable Save for project simulation_case UQ
Paris Perdikaris, George Em Karniadakis Journal of The Royal Society Interface 2016-05-01 10.1098/rsif.2015.1107
单位: Department of Mechanical Engineering, Massachusetts Institute of Technology, Cambridge, MA 02139, USA
通讯: Paris Perdikaris @ Department of Mechanical Engineering, Massachusetts Institute of Technology, Cambridge, MA 02139, USA
相关性: 该论文提出的多保真贝叶斯优化框架可高效解决昂贵仿真中的参数估计问题，与用户关注的代理模型加速设计优化方向高度相关。
边界: The paper focuses on parameter estimation in haemodynamics rather than implant/biomechanics design, and does not address multi-objective optimization with constraints or uncertainty quantification for surrogate models.
动机· 减少昂贵仿真中参数估计所需的函数评估次数
方法· 结合多保真信息融合与贝叶斯优化，利用高斯过程构建响应面并自适应采样
结果· 在血流动力学边界条件校准和椭圆PDE反问题中验证了方法的有效性
验证· 通过三个数值仿真案例（1D/3D血流模型和椭圆PDE）进行验证
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To minimize the number of expensive function evaluations in parameter estimation problems by leveraging multi-fidelity information and Bayesian optimization.
Method· A framework that trains correlated Gaussian process surrogates on multi-fidelity data and uses predictive posterior variance to guide adaptive sampling within Bayesian optimization.
Result· The method accurately identifies parameters in haemodynamic boundary condition calibration and an elliptic PDE inverse problem with limited computational budget.
Validation· Validated on three simulation cases: two involving blood flow model calibration (1D and 3D) and one elliptic PDE inverse problem.

COMPARISON OF THE PRIMARY STABILITY OF COLLARED AND COLLARLESS CEMENTLESS FEMORAL STEMS

High Hip Implant & Femoral Stem openalex Direct Read now simulation_case Patient-specific
Rami Al‐Dirini, Mark Taylor, Dermot O’Rourke, D. Huff Journal of Bone and Joint Surgery-british Volume 2016-05-01 link
单位: Flinders University, Adelaide, Australia
通讯: Rami Al‐Dirini @ Flinders University, Adelaide, Australia
相关性: 该论文直接评估了股骨柄假体的初始稳定性，包括微动和界面应变，与用户研究方向高度相关。
边界: This paper does not report stress shielding or bone remodeling, and does not compare intact vs implanted femur for strain distribution.
动机· 比较有无领的骨水泥型股骨柄的初始稳定性。
方法· 基于八具尸体股骨QCT数据建立有限元模型，施加步态载荷。
结果· 有领和无领假体的微动和界面应变无显著差异。
验证· 通过配对t检验比较两种设计在同一股骨上的表现。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To determine whether a collar contributes to the primary stability of cementless femoral stems, given conflicting evidence from experimental and finite element studies.
Method· Finite element models of eight cadaveric femurs from QCT scans were implanted with collared and collarless Corail stems, and gait loading was applied to compare micromotion and interface microstrains.
Result· No significant differences in micromotion or interface strains were found between collared and collarless designs, with mean micromotions of 19.4 and 20.5 microns, respectively.
Validation· Paired t-tests were used to compare outcomes within the same femur cohort, accounting for inter-specimen variation.

相关性: 该论文直接研究髋关节假体微动，与用户研究方向高度相关。
边界: This paper does not include patient-specific geometry or bone quality variation, and does not compare intact vs implanted femur.
动机· 研究术后压配结合接触或间隙对无骨水泥柄微动的影响。
方法· 对复合骨植入股骨柄进行有限元分析，模拟爬楼梯载荷，设置28种接触条件。
结果· 压配结合接触时微动小于结合间隙，但随压配面积增加差异减小。
验证· 有限元仿真，无实验验证。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To investigate how the combination of press-fit with contact or gap at the stem-bone interface affects the primary stability of cementless femoral stems.
Method· A finite element study was conducted on a composite bone implanted with a femoral stem under stair climbing loading, with 28 cases varying press-fit, contact, and gap conditions across four interface regions.
Result· Micromotion was lower when press-fit was combined with contact than with gap, but the difference decreased as the press-fit area increased.
Validation· Simulation-based study without experimental validation.

动机· 评估股骨翻修柄初始稳定性时需考虑植入物非刚性行为。

Method· A novel in vitro measurement method was developed to locally measure micromotion of both implant and bone under cyclic loading.
Result· Non-rigid behavior significantly influences the evaluation of initial stability.
Validation· The method was validated through in vitro experiments measuring micromotion under cyclic load.

单位: Radboud university medical centre, Nijmegen, Netherlands
通讯: P.K. Tomaszewski @ Radboud university medical centre, Nijmegen, Netherlands
相关性: 该论文直接评估了短髋关节假体的初始稳定性和骨重塑，与用户的研究方向高度相关。
边界: This paper does not include patient-specific geometry or population-based analysis, and does not compare intact vs implanted femur in terms of stress shielding.
动机· 评估短髋关节假体的初始稳定性和骨重塑性能
方法· 基于CT数据建立有限元模型，模拟正常行走和爬楼梯载荷
结果· U形截面短柄假体在稳定性和骨保存方面优于实心短柄，与长柄相当

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To evaluate the initial stability and bone remodeling of a short hip stem design with solid and U-shaped cross-sections.
Method· A finite element model of an osteopenic femur was developed from CT data, and simulations were performed under walking and stair climbing loads from musculoskeletal analysis.
Result· The U-shaped short stem showed slightly higher micromotions than the long stem but significantly less bone loss, especially in proximal Gruen zones.
Validation· Bone remodeling predictions were validated against clinical DEXA measurements for the long stem.

相关性: 该论文直接针对髋关节假体设计，量化了应力遮挡、微动和界面应力，并使用了机器学习框架进行优化，与用户的研究方向高度相关。
边界: This paper does not provide explicit micromotion values with contact/friction modeling for the optimized design; it uses a neural network to predict micromotion rather than reporting direct FE contact results.
动机· 优化股骨假体几何形状以减少应力遮挡和微动。
方法· 结合神经网络、遗传算法和有限元分析的多准则优化框架。
结果· 优化设计减少了近端骨吸收并促进了早期骨长入。

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To optimize femoral implant geometry by minimizing stress shielding, interface stresses, and initial micromotion in cementless total hip arthroplasty.
Method· A multi-criteria optimization framework integrating a neural network for micromotion prediction, genetic algorithm, and finite element analysis was employed.
Result· The trade-off stem geometry reduced proximal bone resorption to ~30% and achieved faster early bone ingrowth compared to a generic design.
Validation· The optimized design was evaluated using a combined bone remodeling and ingrowth simulation with evolutionary interface conditions.

通讯: Fernando J. Quevedo González @ Ecole de technologie supérieure, Montreal, Canada
相关性: 该论文直接针对髋关节假体应力遮挡问题，通过优化股骨柄形状和功能梯度材料属性来减少骨吸收和头部位移，与用户研究方向高度相关。
边界: This paper does not report micromotion values with contact/friction modeling, nor does it compare intact vs implanted femur in a patient-specific manner.
动机· 减少髋关节假体应力遮挡导致的骨吸收和界面微动问题。
方法· 使用有限元模拟和遗传算法优化股骨柄形状及功能梯度材料属性。
结果· 优化后骨吸收率从36%降至15-26%（优质骨），头部位移略有变化。

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To mitigate stress shielding and interfacial micromotion in hip prostheses by optimizing stem shape and material properties.
Method· A 2D finite element model of a femur with a parametrized stem geometry and functionally graded material grid was optimized using a genetic algorithm to minimize bone resorption and head displacement.
Result· Optimized designs reduced bone resorption from 36% to 15-26% for good bone quality, with head displacement changes within 0.5 mm.
Validation· Bone resorption was quantified by comparing strain energy density between intact and implanted femurs under stair-climbing loading.

Motivation· To evaluate the long-term clinical outcomes and periprosthetic bone density changes of a composite isoelastic femoral stem.
Method· A retrospective analysis of 51 primary THA patients with PhysioLogic stem, followed for a median of 14 years using Harris Hip Score and DXA.
Result· The stem showed excellent survival, with no aseptic loosening and most patients reporting equivalent or superior comfort compared to standard stems.
Validation· Clinical follow-up and dual-energy X-ray absorptiometry (DXA) for bone density assessment.

Motivation· High revision rates of total ankle replacements are linked to early micromotion hindering osseointegration, motivating computational assessment of implant stability.

Motivation· To characterize metal ion release from modular hip prostheses with different junctions and material combinations under corrosive physiological conditions.
Method· Cyclic axial compressive loading was applied to modular and monobloc hip implants embedded in PMMA, with testing in various fluids including Ringer's solution, bovine calf serum, and iron chloride solutions.
Result· Modular implants showed significantly increased total metal ion release due to the additional stem-neck interface, comparable to monobloc stems with CoCrMo heads; ceramic heads reduced cobalt and chromium release.

动机· 类风湿关节炎患者股骨近端骨质疏松，传统锉磨技术会丢失松质骨。

结果· 术后随访显示无松动、无肺栓塞，Harris评分显著改善。

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To preserve cancellous bone in osteoporotic proximal femurs of rheumatoid arthritis patients during total hip arthroplasty.
Method· A non-broaching, non-rasping impaction technique was used to insert the femoral stem, followed by cement fixation without a cement mantle.
Result· No loosening or adverse events were observed; Harris Hip Score improved from 32.7 to 79.4 at mean 62-month follow-up.
Validation· Clinical and radiographic evaluation of 31 joints with minimum 12-month follow-up.

相关性: 该论文仅报告了全髋关节置换术的临床结果，未涉及股骨柄应力遮挡或微动的力学分析。
边界: No biomechanical modeling, no FEA, no stress shielding or micromotion quantification, no implant design or contact mechanics.
动机· 评估年轻患者使用大直径金属头与第一代高交联聚乙烯的髋关节置换中期效果。
方法· 回顾性分析31例50岁以下患者，使用特定假体组合，随访至少5年。
结果· 功能评分良好，无脱位、骨溶解等并发症，磨损率低。
验证· 临床随访和Harris评分评估。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To evaluate mid-term clinical outcomes of 36mm metallic femoral heads with first-generation HXLPE in patients aged 50 years or younger.
Method· Retrospective study of 31 THA cases using cementless or cemented stems with a consistent acetabular cup and HXLPE liner.
Result· Good functional scores, low wear rates, and no major complications at minimum 5-year follow-up.
Validation· Clinical follow-up with Harris hip score and radiographic assessment.

通讯: Brendan Kelly @ Summit Orthopedics - Woodbury, USA
相关性: 该论文仅关注全膝关节置换术的患者报告结果，未涉及髋关节植入物或股骨柄的生物力学分析。
边界: This paper does not quantify proximal femur stress/strain, micromotion, or any biomechanical modeling; it is a clinical outcomes study without FEA or implant mechanics.
动机· 比较门诊与住院全膝关节置换术的患者报告结果差异
方法· 回顾性分析96名门诊和152名住院患者的Oxford髋关节评分等数据
结果· 门诊患者术后3个月功能改善和疼痛缓解显著优于住院患者
验证· 基于临床问卷数据的统计分析
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To compare patient-reported outcome measures between outpatient and inpatient total knee arthroplasty.
Method· Retrospective analysis of Oxford Hip Score, VAS pain, and treatment satisfaction questionnaires from 96 outpatient and 152 inpatient TKA patients.
Result· Outpatients showed significantly greater improvements in function and pain relief at 3 months postoperatively compared to inpatients.
Validation· Statistical analysis of clinical questionnaire data.

James D. Wernlé, J Bischoff, Judd S. Day Journal of Bone and Joint Surgery-british Volume 2016-05-01 link

通讯: James D. Wernlé @ Zimmer Inc., Warsaw, USA
相关性: 该论文研究肩关节假体的腐蚀疲劳测试，与髋关节假体应力遮挡和微动分析无关。
边界: This paper focuses on shoulder implant corrosion fatigue testing, not on hip implant stress shielding, micromotion, or proximal femur biomechanics.
动机· 开发肩关节假体加速腐蚀疲劳测试方法
方法· 设计解剖型和反置型肩关节假体ACF测试，加载载荷和方向基于文献数据
结果· 反置型假体在较低载荷下因偏移更大导致更高磨损
验证· 与临床取出假体损伤评分对比验证
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To develop an accelerated corrosion fatigue test specific for shoulder prostheses to evaluate taper damage.
Method· Anatomic and reverse shoulder ACF tests were designed with loads and orientations from instrumented shoulder data and literature.
Result· Reverse implants showed higher taper damage due to increased humeral offset despite lower loads.
Validation· In vitro damage scores were compared to clinical retrieval study scores.
